question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

________ his previous start - ups have failed.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"All"** means the whole amount or every one of something. (सभी)

 
 
• **Example: All** his efforts were in vain.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill in the blank is **'All'** as it indicates **that every single one of his previous start-ups have failed**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'All.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Little **(थोड़ा): A small amount or not much.

 
 
• **Example:** There is** little **water left in the bottle.
 
 
 
• **Quite **(काफी ): To a certain extent or degree.
 
 
• **Example: **She is **quite** tired after the long journey.
 
 
 
• **Very** (बहुत): Used to emphasize an adjective or adverb.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie was** very** interesting.
